lines.zh: 我拖着铁腿走，电在地里跳。
lines.en: I drag my iron legs; sparks skip the ground.

lines.zh: 袭击的队伍里，我走最前。
lines.en: In the raid I walk ahead of all.

lines.zh: 线圈嗡一声，我就前进一步。
lines.en: My coil hums and I advance a step.

lines.zh: 我肩上的电极互相撞响。
lines.en: The electrodes on my shoulders clash.
Grass chars where my boots fall.
No detours. Straight at the village.

lines.zh: 电弧在我身后拖成一条线。
lines.en: An arc trails behind me.
I step over the fence; splinters fly.

lines.zh: 沉重的步子把地压出坑。
lines.en: My heavy steps dent the soil.

lines.zh: 嗡鸣越来越响，说明我在靠近。
lines.en: The hum grows louder as I near.

lines.zh: 灾厄的号角一响，我就动。
lines.en: The horn sounds and I move.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但没人拦得住。
lines.en: Slow, yet nothing stops me.

lines.zh: 我站着，电流在铁壳里转。
lines.en: Standing, current coils in my shell.
The hum drops. I am charging.
Something boils inside the iron.
The electrodes pulse like breath.

lines.zh: 我等号角，等下一步命令。
lines.en: I wait for the horn and the order.
This body needs no sleep.
Now and then a spark drops.

lines.zh: 我的关节锈了一点，无妨。
lines.en: My joints rust a little. No matter.

lines.zh: 村民的灯还亮着，太远了。
lines.en: Village lamps still burn. Too far.
I am still. So is the current.
You block the raid's path.
I know that armor.
The electrodes face you. Keep off.

lines.zh: 灾厄让我们拆掉这村子。
lines.en: The illagers sent us to break it.

lines.zh: 你救不了他们，一个也救不了。
lines.en: You cannot save them. Not one.
My shell is full of charge.
Your bow will not pierce me.
Look at this arm. Wide enough?

lines.zh: 退到十格以外，我提醒一次。
lines.en: Ten blocks back. One warning.
You carry the smell of villagers.

lines.zh: 焊缝裂开，火花从缝里冒。
lines.en: A weld splits and sparks spit from the seam.
A short, and sparks fly.
A little welding will fix this.
My electrodes are askew.
A leg sticks, but still moves.
One notch less charge.

lines.zh: 我的电流在甲片之间跳。
lines.en: Current arcs between my plates.
The hum goes off key. Ugly.
I step back and recharge.
Iron does not hurt. It rings.
Iron? My shell has plenty.
That copper ingot has some use.
Food means nothing to an iron shell.

lines.zh: 雷雨天我更喜欢，别拿东西。
lines.en: I prefer storms. Keep your gifts.

lines.zh: 你举着磁石，我的肩在抖。
lines.en: You hold a lodestone; my shoulders twitch.

lines.zh: 把它放下，我考虑不追你。
lines.en: Put it down and I may not chase.
I take no offerings, only charge.
Toss that iron farther off.
Save that copper coil for me.

lines.zh: 别用金子，那玩意儿不导电。
lines.en: Not gold. It does not conduct.
You bumped me and got a shock.

lines.zh: 我的铁腿不是路障，是墙。
lines.en: My leg is not an obstacle. It is a wall.

lines.zh: 别贴，电弧会跳到你身上。
lines.en: Stay off. The arc will jump to you.
Your hair still stands as you back off.
One touch numbs half your hand.
Iron on iron. A grating sound.
I do not shove. I discharge.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的电极上，可惜。
lines.en: You hit an electrode. Unfortunate.
Make way. I am bound for the gate.
Lucky for you, that was a weak arc.
Iron and copper are not made that way.
We are assembled, not born.
An illager smith built me.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，只会互相放电。
lines.en: When we meet, we only discharge.

lines.zh: 这问题，铁壳里没有答案。
lines.en: The iron shell holds no answer.
I need current, not company.

lines.zh: 别拿这个开玩笑，会短路。
lines.en: Do not joke about it. It shorts me.

lines.zh: 电纳魔是我唯一的朋友。
lines.en: The Tesla is my only companion.
My remainder holds only raids.

lines.zh: 问点别的，比如怎么修我。
lines.en: Ask something else, like how to repair me.
This broken Tesla I will take.
A broken coil can still be fixed.
Iron goes to the warband.

lines.zh: 我用手掌吸起一枚齿轮。
lines.en: I draw a gear up with my palm.
Copper wire on the ground. Do not step.
I lift it; sparks jump from my fingers.
This iron is rusted. Still usable.
Into my shell, so it is not lost.

lines.zh: 你的箭，我拔了插回给你。
lines.en: I pull your arrow and hand it back.
Everything in place keeps the current steady.
You stand at the crossing. You are the target.
The electrodes light. I am charging.
The horn gave the order. Go.
Lock complete. Do not run.
I will take your shield apart first.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁，会引我过去。
lines.en: The iron on you draws me in.
A live grid spreads beneath your feet.
This area belongs to the raid.

lines.zh: 嗡鸣升到最高，我出手了。
lines.en: The hum peaks. I strike.
Did you see that arc?

lines.zh: 你站着不动，电弧正好落下。
lines.en: You stand still, and the arc falls right on you.
I do not shout. I discharge.
Retreat and I widen the field.
The first warning is spent.
There is enough charge for three.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，电弧拉长。
lines.en: I close in; the arc stretches.
Your shield is close. It will conduct.
I do not chase fast. I chase sure.

lines.zh: 脚下的草全焦了，你看着。
lines.en: The grass chars around me. Look.
You circle. I circle.

lines.zh: 电场的边在你脚前三格。
lines.en: The field's edge is three blocks off.
I raise my right arm and charge.
You stop, and I move.

lines.zh: 嗡鸣在耳朵里绕，很难受吧。
lines.en: The hum rings in your ears, no?
Back up and the village is behind you.
I need not look. The iron tells me.

lines.zh: 距离四格，正是放电的距。
lines.en: Four blocks. Perfect discharge range.

lines.zh: 我压低铁肩，蓄满这一击。
lines.en: I lower my iron shoulder and charge the blow.

lines.zh: 你的剑尖在颤，电跟着颤。
lines.en: Your sword tip trembles, and the lightning trembles with it.
One beat more and the field peaks.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，电弧就响一次。
lines.en: Every step you take, the arc clicks.
I push you toward the fence.

lines.zh: 这条路，只通向我的手臂。
lines.en: This path ends at my arm.
My iron fist falls; the ground blackens.

lines.zh: 电弧扫过去，你麻了半边。
lines.en: The arc sweeps; half of you numbs.
I discharge, not merely strike.
This one reaches wider than you think.
You are thrown into the wall.
My shell hits; your shield cracks.

lines.zh: 我的拳头带电，握着别动。
lines.en: My fist carries charge. Hold still.
My arm passes; the air smells burnt.
One more and you will drop.
I do not stop, and neither does the charge.
That blow took the fence down too.
You retreat; the arc follows.
My leg stamps; your footing fails.

lines.zh: 电弧顺着你的剑爬上来。
lines.en: The arc climbs up your sword.

lines.zh: 电从我的肩跳到你的胸。
lines.en: The charge leaps from my shoulder to you.
The hum drowns out your shout.

lines.zh: 袭击开始，我从队伍里走出。
lines.en: The raid begins; I step from the ranks.
Storm clouds gather and I land.
The hum arrives, then the iron.
Three horn calls and I wake.
The village bell rings. I come.
The electrodes light for the first time.

lines.zh: 我从灾厄的营地被推出来。
lines.en: I am pushed out of the illager camp.
The shell lands and flattens the grass.
This street is mine today.
Do you hear that low hum?

lines.zh: 工匠把我拼好，我就出发。
lines.en: The smith finished me. I set out.
The raid banner goes up.
Fire heats my coils red.
I land from height and my leg bends.
Water gets in and the charge scatters.
The blast peels off half my shell.
An arrowhead jams between electrodes.
Magic snuffs my coils.

lines.zh: 没有电补充，我越来越慢。
lines.en: Without charge, I slow down.

lines.zh: 雷击过载了，我全身冒烟。
lines.en: Lightning overloads me; I smoke.
The void drags my iron shell down.
